body:
When I was seventeen, I went camping with six friends and my boyfriend, Luke. We decided to use a field on Luke's grandparents' farm to set up a tent and build a campfire.
As we were roasting hot dogs and marshmallows, my friend pulled out some acid tabs. He passed them around and everybody but me took some. I was the only one there who had never taken acid. So, I refused at first. But, Luke talked me into it and slipped five tabs onto my tongue. At first, nothing happened, but eventually, I started seeing weird shapes in the campfire and sat staring at it, transfixed.
At one point, Luke nudged me in the arm and pointed. Not ten feet from our campsite stood a cow. Seemingly harmless, it stood grazing. I got up and took two steps toward it. It looked up, mooed, and turned into a terrible monster. All I saw was black, white and blood. Screaming, I ran away from the campsite, not stopping until I almost literally ran into a fence. I'd reached the backyard of the farm.
Luke's grandmother stood taking the wash from the clothesline. Terrified that she might see me, I turned and ran back the way I'd come until I reached the campsite, collapsing next to the fire. I watched it's weird shapes and ignored my friends making fun of me. To this day, they still tease me about cows.
